name: Psytrance
blurb: A clicky kick and a bass that fires three times between each one.

sounds.name: Rolling bass
sounds.why: Three very short, plucked bass notes after every kick, all on one pitch. Kick and bass together make one galloping machine.

ingredients.name: One sawtooth
ingredients.adds: A bass note on every sixteenth.

ingredients.name: Leave the kick's slot empty
ingredients.adds: Drops the first sixteenth of every beat.
ingredients.listenFor: With In context on: kick, then three bass notes, over and over.

ingredients.name: Pluck the filter
ingredients.adds: Each note opens the filter for an instant, then it shuts.
ingredients.listenFor: A hard "k" on the front of every note.

knobs.label: pluck depth
knobs.below: Soft and round: a trance bass.

ingredients.name: Very short notes
ingredients.adds: Each note is over long before the next starts.

knobs.above: The notes touch and the gallop is gone.

pitfalls: Bass notes long enough to touch the kick blur the one thing this style depends on.

sounds.why: Short, clicky and tuned to the key of the track, so it reads as the first note of the bassline.
Straight, simple and quiet. The kick and bass are the groove; the hats only mark time.

sounds.name: Squelch lead
sounds.pattern: note("e3 e4 ~ e3 g3 ~ e4 b3").fast(2)
sounds.why: An acid line moved up into lead range, with more resonance, twisting over the top of the bass.

sounds.name: Zap
sounds.why: A tone that falls several octaves in a fraction of a second, thrown into an echo. Psytrance is full of these one-shot noises between phrases.

ingredients.name: A high sine
ingredients.adds: A plain beep at the start of each bar.

ingredients.name: Make it fall
ingredients.adds: The note starts far above its pitch and dives.

knobs.label: fall
knobs.above: It starts above what you can hear.

knobs.label: fall time
knobs.above: A slow slide, not a zap.

ingredients.name: Cut it off
ingredients.adds: The note ends as the fall ends.

ingredients.name: Throw it into an echo
ingredients.adds: The zap repeats and fades across the bar.

knobs.above: The echoes are as loud as the zap.

ingredients.name: Move it side to side
ingredients.adds: Each zap comes from a different place.

sounds.why: A long noise climb before the kick and bass slam back in.
